name: Legion Shieldbearer
summary: A heavy infantryman in the front rank who covers a comrade with a tower shield.
description: Shieldbearers hold the front of a legion's line, locked together so closely that a single shield covers two soldiers. When the line breaks, it breaks where a shieldbearer has fallen.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.onHit: If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {dc:str} Strength saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

reactions.name: Cover an Ally
reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature within 5 feet of the shieldbearer is hit by an attack roll. *Response:* The shieldbearer adds 2 to that creature's AC against the attack, possibly causing it to miss.
